name: A Bite of Candy
overview: The story of Xu Tang, a cute girl who dreams of becoming a cartoonist, and the talented painter Shen Queyan, who become acquainted by an unexpected encounter. Xu Tang mistakenly thought that Shen Queyan was a down-and-out painter who was kept by a rich woman. Amidst many misunderstandings and jokes, the two gradually approached. Faced with family obstacles, career challenges and emotional competition, they grow together and finally work together to overcome everything, from knowing and loving each other to staying together, and reaping sweet love and a happy career.
